questions.answer: Semantic, Morphology, Azerbaijani language and literature, Turkish language in Europe, Turkish Language communication, Turkish Mythology, Study in  examples of Azebaijani literature

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Semantic is very deep subject but the teaching was very well organized. Turkish Mythology is one of the most interesting and exiting subjects. Turkish communicative skills in Tömer and Morphology courses is necessary for learning of Turkish language.
